claims.text: the car pulls forward out of the dark
a black sports car on a showroom floor
Faint light catches the carbon-fibre body as the car emerges from darkness toward clearer light.

description.text: rests on the empty floor, its carbon-fibre body held in deep shadow. The surrounding space is quiet and bare, with a broad expanse of dark floor stretching away from the vehicle and the faintest available light tracing the edges of its silhouette. The car remains still at the brink of movement, a black form almost absorbed by the darkness, while the open floor ahead reads as a flat, unbroken surface. Nothing else occupies the room; the vehicle and the shadowed space around it fill the view, and the low sheen along the body is the only separation between the car and the dark.
The showroom is almost entirely dark;
sits motionless on the empty floor, its carbon-fibre body barely separated from the surrounding shadow. The floor beneath and around the car is bare, and no other object breaks the dim space.
A low engine idle hums quietly through the empty showroom, steady and subdued.
The showroom floor opens ahead as

pulls forward, leaving the deepest shadow behind. The dark body rolls through the dim space, its carbon-fibre surfaces gathering a soft sheen as the car advances. The empty floor continues in front of it, a plain surface that catches only a trace of light, and the vehicle's movement carries it out of the dark toward clearer illumination. The car's shape becomes more distinct as it moves, with the body holding its low, smooth profile while the space around it remains bare and quiet.
The engine note rises as the tyres begin to roll, a low mechanical sound building under the car.
pulls forward across the showroom floor, moving out of the dark with a steady, deliberate advance. The vehicle leaves the deepest shadow behind and rolls toward the clearer part of the dim space.

As the car advances, its carbon-fibre body catches a soft sheen from the faint light, and the empty floor continues ahead in a broad, unbroken stretch. The shape of the vehicle becomes clearer against the shadowed showroom, while the surrounding space stays bare and quiet.

soundscape: A low engine idle in the empty showroom, rising to a rolling engine note as the car pulls forward.
